Results.ReviewText: This grill replaced one that was 20 years old.  The Spirit is far more efficient in propane usage, heats more evenly and gets hotter (when needed) than the grill it replaced. It is also much, much easier to clean. The controls are intuitive, making the transition easy.
Results.Title: Change for the Better

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect for the single women, right size, 3 burners for smaller meals, takes up minimal space!
Results.Title: My First

Results.ReviewText: Nice gas grill.  Good starting and heat control.  Quality surface finish on materials.
Results.Title: E-325 Grille (LP)

Results.ReviewText: After retiring my older Weber Genesis grill probably 20 years old and searching for a replacement I found good reviews on the Spirit grill. Very happy with it after cooking on 5x
Results.Title: Does a great job

Results.ReviewText: Awesome quality grill,cooks evenly when cooking a large batch. Heats up quick.
Results.Title: Great quality grill.

ClientResponses.Response:
Congratulations on your first Weber grill! We are pleased to hear that you are enjoying it, though we apologize for the burner frustration. Our grills are designed for the outdoors, so if a regular breeze shouldn't blow out the flame. We can troubleshoot this issue and improve your experience!

Stronger winds might affect the performance, and we recommend rotating the grill 90 degrees to avoid the direct gusts, if possible. 

Our team is here to help! Please look for an email outreach soon.
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: This is the first grill that I've bought. While it heats up very efficiently, I'm surprised how sensitive the grill is to the breeze. We live nearby the ocean, where the wind is probably above average, and flame shuts off almost without fail.
Results.Title: Grill heats up quick but sensitive to breeze

Results.ReviewText: This grill works great for a gas grill. Easy to light and cooks food evenly. It’s very easy to removed grates and cover to clean.
Results.Title: Good choice for gas grill

Results.ReviewText: Great dependable quality product. We own Weber at home and now purchased for our vacation home too.
Results.Title: Great dependable quality product.

Results.ReviewText: I received the grill around September 8, 2025.  While assembling it I noticed that the door for the lower compartment was bent.  Luckily this did not affect the operation of the grill which works great.  Lots of heat and control with the 3 burners.  I contacted Weber Mexico about the bent door on September 9 and they assured me that they would send me a new one.  As I write this on October 25 I still have not received the replacement door.  Very frustrating.
Results.Title: Works great but arrived damaged

Results.ReviewText: I'll never buy anything but a weber grills. The best!!
Results.Title: Weber grills

ClientResponses.Response:
We appreciate your feedback on the Spirit E-325 Gas Grill. We understand your concern about the wheels, and we apologize for any inconvenience. When moving the grill, we recommend gripping the edge of the side table to lift and move the grill like a bandwagon. You can also use the side table handle to move the grill. 

We hope this information helps. Please don’t hesitate to reach out to us if you need further assistance with your grill. We are always here to help. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: This Weber Unit needs four wheels. Its to hard to move around with just two.
Results.Title: Wheels

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We understand your concern about moving the grill to another location, and we apologize for any inconvenience. There is no handle available to replace the side table to move the grill. We recommend gripping the edge of the side table to lift and move the grill to another location.

We are sorry to hear the front panel is bent. Our Care Team will reach out to help. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText:
Have had the Spirit E-325 gas grill for about 5 months. Works very well for all types of grilling. 
I do have a concern about the engineering of the base of the grill. It has the two wheels on the rear of the grill with no handle on the front to lift and move grill. My grill is kept in the garage and moved outside when I grill. 
The side shelf needs to be raised and is the only thing that can be used an a handle. The front panel is now bent out where the shelf attaches. Is there a handle that you offer that I could purchase.
Results.Title: Needs handle to move grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is just the right size for the two of us and has been good so far.  We've only had it for a month, so the review is in the early stages of owning it.  In particular, I like the searing feature, which isn't available on a lot of other grills, including some less expensive Weber grills.  The only reason I didn't give it five stars is because of the grease pan filling up with rain water.  I can't figure out how the rain is getting into it, as the lid is closed, but with a heavy rain, the pan overflows and grease is on the bottom of the grill and the floor.
Results.Title: Four stars because of one problem

Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with my purchase. This BBQ addresses all of the design flaws of previous BBQs I have owned. It is easy to fully clean, with a removable bottom assembly and easy access fat tray. Debris will not build up and interfere with the burners. The burners are solid tubes with no compression points, the usual spot for burners to rust out. The unit heats quickly and holds heat well. The grills are solid cast metal that are widely spaced and easy to clean. The side shelves are solild ceramic covered metal, eliminating the grease stain issue with plastic shelves. The handle is solild metal, including the brackets that mount to the lid which will ensure they will last compared to other BBQs. This is a quality product that fully justififies its higher price.
Results.Title: Great design

ClientResponses.Response:
We apologize for the inconvenience with your grill's gas connection. That's not the quality we expect. We are also sorry for any frustration caused when troubleshooting with our Care team. 

We see that you received a new part, and should be back to grilling. Please look for a follow-up from us soon!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: Grill had a faulty gas feed hose that needed replacing 6 months after purchase.  The grill was purchased at ABT and their customer service was excellent.  The Weber on line experience was horrible…and the Weber customer service person continued to ask questions about the problem even though the ABT Grill team had already been out and diagnosed the problem.
Results.Title: Mediocre product and poor customer service

Results.ReviewText: Best BBQ I have owned. Nice even heat. Nice sear feature
Results.Title: Spirit BbQ

Results.ReviewText: Nice sturdy unit, cooks well and temperature is easy to regulate
Results.Title: Weber E-325

Results.ReviewText: Great features, perfect size for 2, easy to keep clean, even heating, great unit
Results.Title: Great New Grill

Results.ReviewText: After being a "Charcoal" guy for 40 years, going to a gas grill is a learning curve. But continue to use & learn as it does cook HOT. Overall VERY happy with the grill!
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: Very easy to assemble with clear instructions. Main reason I purchased it was the slide out lower tray assembly for cleaning and the two searing zone burners to sear my steaks.
Results.Title: First Weber Product

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill about a month ago and have broken it in heavily. I had 3 housewarming parties each with over 10 people at a time. This grill was able to handle making 12 burgers, 12 brats, and 8 hotdogs in about 45 minutes and able to keep other meats warm while cooking more. It seems to use propane efficiently as well. It’s still quite new, but so far so good.
Results.Title: Great grill so far

Results.ReviewText: My old Weber 2 burner grill finally died.   I went to my Ace hardware store and found that Weber no longer offer a 2 burner grill for natural gas.   I had to purchase a 3 burner version for about $100 more  than a 2 burner version.   Works great but not happy about Weber celeting the 2 burner natural gas version.
Results.Title: Fine grill but I wanted a 2 burner natural gas

Results.ReviewText: Love the grill. Gets hot fast and holds temperature. Just wish Weber would have have a better back panel.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I grill all year round up here in New England. Most of my Weber grills last about ten years. When I need a part or two, they are readily available at the hardware store.
Results.Title: Snow seasoned steak.

Results.ReviewText: Everything about this grill is great - except one flaw. The the pan does not provide complete coverage. Grease ends up dripping into the cabinet and onto the tank.
Results.Title: little short on coverage

Results.ReviewText: Nice built grill. The burners are made to last and you can get it up to 700 degrees quickly. The wheels could had been made better/bigger, and a back to the grill is showing the fuel tank, a back panel would be nice. Overall, the grates are nice, the box is heavy built, and i like the bottom pull out panel to clean up all of the grease/debris from grilling.
Results.Title: Its a Keeper!!

Results.ReviewText: Great price and great performance. Perfect mid-sized BBQ and the sear function is very handy. Very well built, solid all round. My first one had problems with ignition, Weber replaced it very quickly with no hassles.
Results.Title: Great all round.

Results.ReviewText: Great little barbecue. Love it. The searing option is fabulous.
Results.Title: Small but mighty. Very pleased.

Results.ReviewText: Perfect for smaller deck and retired couple who do not require full size grill.  Heats fast and even, add cast iron griddle and it is perfect replacement for gas range!!
Results.Title: Best weber

Results.ReviewText: It was time to replace my 30 yr old Genesis. Only the 2 of us here now so I got a smaller bbq this time. Easy to assemble (pay attention to L & R markings)… cooks a 1-1/2” ribeye just fine.. really like the searing feature.
Results.Title: Great BBQ
